name: dakota-horizons-site
description: Marketing website for Dakota Horizons, a social media marketing agency.

scripts.pages:dev: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev _site
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy _site --project-name dakota-horizons
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply dakota-horizons-leads --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply dakota-horizons-leads --remote
